name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3334: THE THIRD CUT, AND A SECOND EYE MEASURED THE SECOND ONE CLOSING THE LANE. v3331 allow-listed the interpreters that may run the pre-push hook and failed OPEN on unknown wrappers: 5 of 10 wrong, all false negatives. v3332 inverted that to a deny-list of readers and failed CLOSED far too hard. MEASURED on 11 probes: 7 were FALSE POSITIVES. find with a path flag, rsync, tar on a dot-tar file, node on a dot-json file, git branch push, git log with grep push, and git checkout minus b push each read as a running gate and would have blocked every bump for the duration of an ordinary inspection command. A guard that refuses on find is an off switch, not a check. NEITHER LIST WORKS ALONE, AND POSITION IS WHAT DECIDES. The hook now counts only where it could plausibly BE the program: the first token after leading environment assignments are stripped, or behind something that executes things. A token sitting after a flag is an ARGUMENT and not a program. The git rule asks for the real SUBCOMMAND, skipping global flags and the values they consume, so a branch or a grep pattern named push no longer reads as a push. The hook path must END at a boundary, so dot-log, dot-bak, dot-tar and dot-json siblings are other files. An unknown leader still fails CLOSED, so the dangerous direction stays guarded. Re-measured across 22 cases: 0 wrong, and a free tree still answers free. 5 red-proofs PROVEN, and one of them came back BLIND with a CORRECT match count: every negative fixture was being rejected earlier by the reader list or the git branch, so the position rule itself had NO coverage and its sabotage changed nothing visible. A fixture whose leader is neither a reader nor a known runner now reaches it. Two further proofs were REMOVED as superseded, their anchors being lines this cut replaced.
